title: Amateur mixed martial arts.
bodyText: This chapter, with the exception of sections 440E-5(b)(5) and 440E-7(a)(2) and (4), shall apply to amateur mixed martial arts contests.
bodyHtml: [§440E-1.5]  Amateur mixed martial arts.  This chapter, with the exception of sections 440E-5(b)(5) and 440E-7(a)(2) and (4), shall apply to amateur mixed martial arts contests. [L 2010, c 117, pt of §1]
